displayAddress: Idaline Court, Cobden Walk, Southwark, London
description:
Key Features: 

Spacious and stylish one-bedroom apartments 

Bespoke furnishings and premium appliances 

Floor-to-ceiling windows for abundant natural light 

Ultra-fast broadband available for all providers throughout all spaces 

Friendly support team 

Communal courtyard 

Pet-friendly environment 




Local Highlights: 

Located on Queens Road Peckham

Excellent transport links, including Queens Road Peckham Station and Peckham Rye Station nearby 

Close proximity to shops, dining, bars, and entertainment venues 



 

Detailed Descriptions:  

Discover the epitome of modern city living with our one-bedroom apartments at Idaline Court, Peckham Place. Designed to be a perfect sanctuary for one or two, these apartments feature bespoke furnishings, stunning floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium fitted appliances. 

Enjoy bright, open-plan spaces with a sleek, stylish design that combines comfort and sophistication. Our ultra-fast broadband is set up and ready to use from the moment you arrive. The pet-friendly policy ensures your furry friends are welcome, and additional amenities include a secure parcel room, library, games room and on-site bike storage. 

 

Located in the heart of Queens Road Peckham offers easy connections to local and major Cities and towns.. With access to a resident-only gym, stone throw away from all the city's main attractions, and regular resident events, this is city living at its finest.
